visualCharacteristics: Featured news item (large image left, category/title/date/excerpt right) followed by a 4-column news grid (image, title, excerpt, date). Featured layout is applied by CSS to the first card. Option 'stacked': featured item rendered as a single large card with full-width image on top and title/date/excerpt/Leia mais below (Noticias listing destaque). Option 'no-featured': plain grid whose column count follows the block width (auto-fill, min 280px per card), e.g. 2 columns inside a 2/3 split section, 4 at full width, 1 on mobile.
contentPattern: One row per news item. Cell 1: image. Cell 2: category paragraph (before heading), title heading (linked), date paragraph (dd/mm/yyyy), summary paragraph(s), 'Leia mais' link paragraph. Same row contract for all options; 'stacked' is typically used with a single row.

cfMapping.category: row cell 2, paragraph(s) before the heading
cfMapping.title: row cell 2, first heading text
cfMapping.link: row cell 2, heading link href (falls back to the 'Leia mais' link)
cfMapping.date: row cell 2, first dd/mm/yyyy paragraph after the heading

usage.description: Home page news band: 1 featured + 4 latest news items.

reuseGuidance: Use for lists of news/articles. Keep the 2-cell row structure stable: it is the contract for producing the markup from AEM headless news-article Content Fragments. Any field can be omitted per item. Put the section heading, intro and 'Leia todas as noticias' button as default content in the same section (section style: centered).
